title: 1982 Topps KMart 20th Anniversary AL NL MVP's Baseball Card Set 1-44
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Sets
descriptionText: The product is a set of 1982 Topps KMart 20th Anniversary AL NL MVP's baseball cards featuring the Most Valuable Players from the American League and National League from 1962. The set includes cards numbered 1-44 and is a part of the Sports Trading Card category. These cards were manufactured by Topps in 1982 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of KMart.
